newsitem.title: USA: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 2,227 CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 2,227 CONTRACTS.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 2,227 contracts compared with 2,088 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 242 wheat, 1,303 corn, 587 soybean, 20 soymeal, 13 soyoil, four wheat puts, 48 corn calls, four corn puts, three soybean calls and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-3/4 to 3-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1/4 cent higher to 2-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were four to 6-1/2 cents lower.
